record.bible_text: Open<WH06605><WTH8798> thy doors<WH01817>, O Lebanon<WH03844>, that the fire<WH0784> may devour<WH0398><WTH8799> thy cedars<WH0730>.

Howl<WH03213><WTH8685>, fir tree<WH01265>; for the cedar<WH0730> is fallen<WH05307><WTH8804>; because the mighty<WH0117> are spoiled<WH07703><WTH8795>: howl<WH03213><WTH8685>, O ye oaks<WH0437> of Bashan<WH01316>; for the forest<WH03293> of the vintage<WH01208><WTH8675><WH01219><WTH8803> is come down<WH03381><WTH8804>. <RF>mighty: or, gallants<Rf> <RF>the forest...: or, the defenced forest<Rf>

<FI> There is<Fi> a voice<WH06963> of the howling<WH03215> of the shepherds<WH07462><WTH8802>; for their glory<WH0155> is spoiled<WH07703><WTH8795>: a voice<WH06963> of the roaring<WH07581> of young lions<WH03715>; for the pride<WH01347> of Jordan<WH03383> is spoiled<WH07703><WTH8795>.<CM>
Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> my God<WH0430>; Feed<WH07462><WTH8798> the flock<WH06629> of the slaughter<WH02028>;

Whose possessors<WH07069><WTH8802> slay<WH02026><WTH8799> them, and hold themselves not guilty<WH0816><WTH8799>: and they that sell<WH04376><WTH8802> them say<WH0559><WTH8799>, Blessed<WH01288><WTH8803> <FI>be<Fi>  the LORD<WH03068>; for I am rich<WH06238><WTH8686>: and their own shepherds<WH07462><WTH8802> pity<WH02550><WTH8799> them not.

For I will no more pity<WH02550><WTH8799> the inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> of the land<WH0776>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>: but, lo, I will deliver<WH04672><WTH8688> the men<WH0120> every one<WH0376> into his neighbour's<WH07453> hand<WH03027>, and into the hand<WH03027> of his king<WH04428>: and they shall smite<WH03807><WTH8765> the land<WH0776>, and out of their hand<WH03027> I will not deliver<WH05337><WTH8686> <FI>them<Fi> . <RF>deliver: Heb. make to be found<Rf>

And I will feed<WH07462><WTH8799> the flock<WH06629> of slaughter<WH02028>, <FI>even<Fi> you<WH03651>, O poor<WH06041> of the flock<WH06629>. And I took<WH03947><WTH8799> unto me two<WH08147> staves<WH04731>; the one<WH0259> I called<WH07121><WTH8804> Beauty<WH05278>, and the other<WH0259> I called<WH07121><WTH8804> Bands<WH02254><WTH8802>; and I fed<WH07462><WTH8799> the flock<WH06629>. <RF>even...: or, verily the poor<Rf> <RF>Bands: or, Binders<Rf>

Three<WH07969> shepherds<WH07462><WTH8802> also I cut off<WH03582><WTH8686> in one<WH0259> month<WH03391>; and my soul<WH05315> lothed<WH07114><WTH8799> them, and their soul<WH05315> also abhorred<WH0973><WTH8804> me. <RF>lothed...: Heb. was straightened for them<Rf>

Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> I, I will not feed<WH07462><WTH8799> you: that that dieth<WH04191><WTH8801>, let it die<WH04191><WTH8799>; and that that is to be cut off<WH03582><WTH8737>, let it be cut off<WH03582><WTH8735>; and let the rest<WH07604><WTH8737> eat<WH0398><WTH8799> every one<WH0802> the flesh<WH01320> of another<WH07468>. <RF>another: Heb. his fellow, or, neighbour<Rf>

And I took<WH03947><WTH8799> my staff<WH04731>, <FI>even<Fi> Beauty<WH05278>, and cut it asunder<WH01438><WTH8799>, that I might break<WH06565><WTH8687> my covenant<WH01285> which I had made<WH03772><WTH8804> with all the people<WH05971>.

And it was broken<WH06565><WTH8714> in that day<WH03117>: and so the poor<WH06041> of the flock<WH06629> that waited<WH08104><WTH8802> upon me knew<WH03045><WTH8799> that it <FI>was<Fi> the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>so...: or, the poor of the flock, etc. certainly knew<Rf>

And I said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto them, If ye think<WH05869> good<WH02896>, give<WH03051><WTH8798> <FI>me<Fi> my price<WH07939>; and if not, forbear<WH02308><WTH8798>. So they weighed<WH08254><WTH8799> for my price<WH07939> thirty<WH07970> <FI>pieces<Fi>  of silver<WH03701>. <RF>If ye...: Heb. If it be good in your eyes<Rf>

And the LORD<WH03068> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto me, Cast<WH07993><WTH8685> it unto the potter<WH03335><WTH8802>: a goodly<WH0145> price<WH03366> that I was prised at<WH03365><WTH8804> of them. And I took<WH03947><WTH8799> the thirty<WH07970> <FI>pieces<Fi>  of silver<WH03701>, and cast<WH07993><WTH8686> them to the potter<WH03335><WTH8802> in the house<WH01004> of the LORD<WH03068>.

Then I cut asunder<WH01438><WTH8799> mine other<WH08145> staff<WH04731>, <FI>even<Fi> Bands<WH02254><WTH8802>, that I might break<WH06565><WTH8687> the brotherhood<WH0264> between Judah<WH03063> and Israel<WH03478>. <RF>Bands: or, Binders<Rf><CM>
And the LORD<WH03068> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto me, Take<WH03947><WTH8798> unto thee yet the instruments<WH03627> of a foolish<WH0196> shepherd<WH07462><WTH8802>.

For, lo, I will raise up<WH06965><WTH8688> a shepherd<WH07462><WTH8802> in the land<WH0776>, <FI>which<Fi> shall not visit<WH06485><WTH8799> those that be cut off<WH03582><WTH8737>, neither shall seek<WH01245><WTH8762> the young one<WH05289>, nor heal<WH07495><WTH8762> that that is broken<WH07665><WTH8737>, nor feed<WH03557><WTH8770> that that standeth<WH05324><WTH8737> still: but he shall eat<WH0398><WTH8799> the flesh<WH01320> of the fat<WH01277>, and tear<WH06561><WH00> their claws<WH06541> in pieces<WH06561><WTH8762>. <RF>cut off: or, hidden<Rf> <RF>feed: or, bear<Rf>

Woe<WH01945> to the idol<WH0457> shepherd<WH07473> that leaveth<WH05800><WTH8802> the flock<WH06629>! the sword<WH02719> <FI>shall be<Fi> upon his arm<WH02220>, and upon his right<WH03225> eye<WH05869>: his arm<WH02220> shall be clean<WH03001><WTH8800> dried up<WH03001><WTH8799>, and his right<WH03225> eye<WH05869> shall be utterly<WH03543><WTH8800> darkened<WH03543><WTH8799>.<CM>
